tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa'i tshul rje bla ma'i dgongs pa gsal bar byed pa rgyal sras 'jug ngogs zhes bya ba bzhugs/
༄༅/ /byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa'i tshul rje bla ma'i dgongs pa gsal bar byed pa rgyal sras 'jug ngogs zhes bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa'i tshul rje bla ma'i dgongs pa gsal bar byed pa rgyal sras 'jug ngogs zhes bya ba bzhugs/

na mo su ma ti kīrti ye/ rgyal ba'i dbang bo rnam 'dren zas gtsang sras/ / rgyal tshab mi pham rje btsun mkhyen pa'i gter/ /rgyal bas lung bstan klu sgrub thogs med sogs/ /rgyal sras 'dzam gling mkhas pa'i tshogs la 'dud/ / 'dir theg pa chen po'i gsung rab du ma'i brjod bya'i snying bo byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i tshul bshad par bya ste/ 'di'i rnam gzhag rgyas par ni rje'i gsung rab las 'byung yang 'dir rang nyid kyis phan yon thob cing gzhan la'ang go bde zhing phan srid snyam nas 'chad pa la dgu/ rgyu mtshan phan yon dang bcas pa/ rten/ rgyu rkyen/ ngo bo/ dbye ba/ sbyong tshul/ skyes pa'i tshad/ cho gas 'dzin tshul/ 'phros don du spyod pa gang la bslab tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ theg chen lam du 'jug par 'dod pa rnams kyis/ byang chub tu sems bskyed dgos pa yin te/ de ltar dgos pa la rgyu mtshan dang*/ phan yon gyi khyad par gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ dang po yod de/ lam rim chen mo las/ de la rgyal bas pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa chen po dang gsang sngags kyi theg pa chen po gnyis gsungs kyi/ de las gzhan pa'i theg pa chen po ni med do/ /de gnyis gang gi sgor 'jug kyang 'jug sgo ni byang chub kyi sems kho na yin te/ de rgyud la nam skyes pa na gzhan gang yang ma skyes kyang theg chen por 'jog pa yin la/ de dang nam bral ba na stong pa nyid kyi rtogs pa la sogs pa'i yon tan ci yod kyang nyan thos la sogs pa'i sar ltung zhing*/ theg chen las nyams par yin par theg pa chen po'i gzhung du ma las gsungs shing rigs pas kyang 'grub pa yin no/ /zhes dang*/ 'di la 'bad nas bcos ma ma yin pa zhig skye rgyu byung na/ des zin pa'i bya rog la zan chang zad cig byin pa'ang byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa zhes bya ba'i grangs su 'gro yi/ 'di med na stong gsum rin po ches bkang ste byin kyang byang chub sems dpa'i spyod par mi chud do/

/de bzhin du tshul khrims nas shes rab kyi bar dang lha bsgom pa dang rtsa rlung thig le sogs bsgom pa'ang byang chub sems dpa'i spyod par mi chud do/ /zhes dang*/ nyams mgur las kyang*/ sems bskyed theg mchog lam gyi gzhung shing ste/ nas/ rab 'byams dge tshogs sdud pa'i bsod nams gter/ zhes gsungs pa ltar yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa phan yon gyi khyad par yod de/ lam rim las/ phan yon yang bsdu na gnyis te/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi phan yon no/ /dang po la'ang ngan 'gror mi ltung ba dang bde 'gror skye ba gnyis te/ sems de skyes na ngan 'gro'i rgyu sngar bsags du ma 'dag pa dang*/ phyis gsog pa rnams rgyun chad pa dang*/ bde 'gro'i rgyu sngar bsags rnams des zin pas rgya cher 'phel ba dang*/ gsar du byed pa rnams kyang des kun nas slong bas zad pa'i mtha' med pa'o/ /mthar thug gi don thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa rnams kyang sems de la brten nas bde blag tu 'grub/ zhes dang*/ mdo las/ byang chub sems kyi bsod nams gang*/ /de la gal te gzugs mchis na/ /nam mkha'i khams ni kun bkang ste/ /de ni de bas lhag par 'gyur/ /zhes dang*/ spyod 'jug las kyang*/ de dang dge mtshungs ga la yod/ /de 'dra'i bshes kyang ga la yod/ / bsod nams de 'dra ga la yod/ /zhes dang*/ sdig pa stobs chen shin tu mi bzad pa/ /de ni rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems min pa/ /dge gzhan gang gis zil gyis gnon par 'gyur/ /zhes dang*/ dge ba gzhan kun chu shing bzhin du ni/ /'bras bu bskyed nas zad par 'gyur ba nyid/ /byang chub sems kyi ljon shing rtag par yang*/ /'bras bu 'byin pas mi zad 'phel bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin pa'i phyir ro/ /des na de lta bu'i phan yon mthong ba'i dad pas yid drangs nas byang chub kyi sems dngos sam de'i gzugs brnyan tsam yin yang rung ste/ bsgom pa la ci nus su 'bad par bya ste/

rje'i zhal nas/ 'on kyang gzugs brnyan tsam las ma byung yang dge rtsa sgrub pa thams cad 'dis rgyas btab cing smon lam gyis kha bsgyur na phan yon dpag tu med pa 'byung bas 'di la nges shes 'drongs pa mdzod/ ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de lta ma yin par sems bskyed pa dka'o snyam du zhum ste/ de rang rgyud la bskyed pa'i rtsis ci yang med par ngag nas theg chen sems bskyed zhes mang du brjod kyang kha phyir bltas kyi shes pa kho nas dal ba don med par mi bya'o/ /gnyis pa rten gang la skye na/ lus rten ni/ spyir rigs drug gi rten la skye zhing*/ sems rten ni/ dad pa dang byams snying rje sogs la brten nas skye'o/ /gsum pa rgyu rkyen gang la brten nas skye na/ spyir rgyu bzhi/ rkyen bzhi/ stobs bzhi las skye ba yod de/ rgyu bzhi ni/ rigs phun sum tshogs pa/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen la brten pa/ sems can la snying rje che ba/ sems can gyi don du 'khor ba'i dka' spyad la mi skyo ba'o/ /rkyen bzhi na/ sangs rgyas byang sems kyi cho 'phrul mthong ngam thos pa/ theg chen gyi sde snod thos pa/ theg chen gyi chos nub par ma bzod pa/ snyigs dus su byang chub tu sems bskyed pa rnyed dka' bar bsam pa'o/ /stobs bzhi ni/ rang gi mthus rdzogs byang 'dod pa rang gi stobs/ gzhan gyi mthus de 'dod pa gzhan gyi stobs/ /sngon theg chen la goms pas da lta sangs rgyas byang sems kyi bsngags pa thos nas mos pa rgyu'i stobs/ sngon dge ba la ring du goms pa sbyor ba'i stobs te/ de dag ci rigs la brten nas skye ba yod do/ /don bsdus pa'i khyad che ba ni/ sems can dpag tu med pa'i don bya'o/ /rgyal sras kyi spyod pa mtha' dag la bslab par bya'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos tshad med pa bsgrub par bya'o snyam du yang yang bsam zhing smon na/ sems de skye ba'i rgyur phul du byung bar 'gyur ro/

/gzhan yang de skye ba'i rgyur tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong byed pa dang*/ khyad par rgyu 'bras man ngag bdun gyi sgo nas sbyong ba dang*/ /bdag gzhan mnyam brje'i sgo nas sbyong tshul yang sems bskyed skye ba'i rgyu rkyen yin la/ 'on kyang 'di skye ba'i rgyu'i gtso bo ni/ sems can sdug bsngal las skyob 'dod kyi snying rje chen po nyid yin te/ rgyu rkyen gzhan ji lta ba bzhin tshang yang 'di nges par dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /bzhi ba ngo bo ni/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ rang gi rgyur gyur pa'i gzhan gyi don du yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod pa'i gzhan don gnyer gyi 'dun pa las byung zhing*/ rang gi grogs su gyur pa'i rang don du'ang rdzogs byang don gnyer gyi 'dun pa dang mtshungs ldan du gyur pa'i theg chen lam gyi 'jug sgo'i rigs su gnas pa'i theg chen gtso bo yid kyi rnam rig khyad par can de/ theg chen sems bskyed kyi mtshan nyid dam ngo bo yin/ 'dir gzhan don don gnyer ni/ sems can la dmigs pa'i byams pa dang snying rje sogs kyis kun nas bslangs te/ de dag gi don du rdzogs byang don du gnyer ba yin la/ rdzogs byang don gnyer ni/ rang don du'ang rdzogs pa'i byang chub don du gnyer ba ste/ theg chen sems bskyed kyi mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa la ni de gnyis ka tshogs dgos kyi/ gang rung res mi chog ste/ lam rim las/ mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i sems bskyed pa ni/ gzhan don la dgos par mthong ba tsam gyis drangs pa'i sangs rgyas thob 'dod tsam gyis mi chog pas/ rang don la'ang sangs rgyas med du mi rung bar mthong ba'i thob 'dod dang*/ de yang gzhan gyi don yal bar bzhag pa min par gzhan gyi phyir du'ang don du gnyer ba zhig dgos te/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/

/lnga pa de la ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye na/ smon sems dang*/ 'jug sems gnyis te/ de gnyis kyi khyad par ni/ sgom rim las/ 'gro ba mtha' dag la phan pa'i sangs rgyas su gyur cig ces gang thog mar don du gnyer ba de ni/ smon pa'i sems so/ /gang phan chad sdom pa bzung ste tshogs rnams la zhugs pa ni 'jug pa'i sems so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don/ lam rim las/ sbyin pa la sogs pa'i spyod pa la slob kyang rung mi slob kyang rung*/ ji srid du sdom pa ma bzung ba de srid du smon pa'i sems yin la/ sdom pa bzung ba nas sems de 'jug sems su shes par bya ste/ zhes bshad pa ltar ro/ /'di la bzhed pa mi 'dra ba mang du yod kyang rje yab sras kyi dgongs pa phyogs gcig tu bsdu na/ smon sems ni/ sdom pa blangs sam ma blangs kyang rung spyod pa nyams len gyi bya bas dngos su zin pa la bltos mi dgos pa'i rigs gnas zhig yin la/ 'jug sems ni/ 'jug sdom thob cing spyod pa nyams len gyi bya bas dngos su zin pa la bltos dgos pa zhig yin no/ /sa mtshams la/ smon sems ni tshogs lam nas sa ma thob kyi bar dang*/ sa bdun pa'i bar du yod par bzhed pa'i tshul sogs mang la/ 'jug sems ni tshogs lam nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar du yod cing*/ dbye ba'i sgo gzhan yang mang ngo*/ /drug pa sbyong ba'i rim pa la gnyis te/ jo bo chen po nas brgyud pa dang*/ /zhi ba lha nas brgyud pa'i sbyor tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ rgyu 'bras man ngag bdun te/ byang chub kyi sems ni/ lhag bsam dang*/ de snying rje/ de byams pa/ de drin gzo ba/ de drin dran pa/ de sems can mar shes pa las 'byung ngo*/ /gong du bshad pa ltar sems bskyed skye ba'i rgyu rkyen mang yang*/ gtso bo ni byams pa dang 'brel ba'i snying rje nyid de/ 'di ni spyir sems can gzhan sdug bsngal gyis mnar tshul yang yang bsams nas skye mod/ de shugs drag pa dang shin tu brtan po skye ba la ni/

sngon du sems can de yid 'ong gi rnam pa can du bsam pa yin la/ de yang sems can thams cad mar shes pa/ drin dran pa sogs goms par byed pa'o/ /de dag bsdu na/ gzhan don gnyer gyi blo sbyong ba dang*/ byang chub don gnyer gyi blo sbyong ba gnyis su 'du bas/ dang po la gnyis/ blo de skye ba'i gzhi dang*/ bskyed tshul dngos sau/ dang po la/ btang snyoms dang*/ yid 'ong gi rnam pa can du bsam pa gnyis kyi/ dang po ni/ byams pa dang snying rje ris su ma chad pa zhig skye ba la sngon du btang snyoms bsgom dgos te/ gzhan du na de gnyis gang skye yang phyogs ris can du skye ba sogs su 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /btang snyoms de yang dang por bar ma/ de nas dgra/ de'i rjes su sems can gzhan la dmigs nas bsgom par bya'o/ /bsgom tshul ni/ sems can gyi ngos nas sdug bsngal mi 'dod cing bde ba 'dod pa sha stag yin pas/ de rnams la mtha' gcig tu chags sdang byed mi rigs so snyam pa dang*/ rang gi ngos nas ni/ sems can rnams la mar gyur ma myong ba med pas gang la ni chags la/ gang la ni sdang par bya snyam du bsam pa'o/ /chags sdang skye ba'i gzhi nges med du bsam pa ni/ ji lta bu'i gnyen byams pa yin zhig kyang*/ de la gnod pa chen po phar byas pa'am/ tshur rang la byas pa gang byung yang*/ rang gzhan gang yin kyang sdang ba skye bar 'gyur la/ ci 'dra ba'i dgra sdang ba zhig yin yang rung ste/ de la phan tshabs chen po zhig phar btags pa'am/ tshur rang la btags byung na ni/ de'i tshe rang gzhan gang yin kyang sdang pa'i sems 'gyur nas byams pa'i sems lta bu zhig skye bas/ dgra gnyen la mtha' gcig tu yid brtan nges par mi thub po snyam du yang yang bsams na khro chags bzlog nas btang snyoms skye bar 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa sems can yid 'ong gi rnam pa can du bsgrub pa la gsum/ sems can thams cad mar shes pa/ drin dran pa/ drin gzo ba'o/

/dang po ni/ skye ba thog ma med pa nas 'khor bar lus 'di ma blangs bya ba ci yang med pas/ sems can 'di ni sngon rang gi mar ma gyur zhes bya ba'ang med do snyam du bsam pa'o/ /gnyis pa drin dran pa ni/ de dag mar gyur nas ni da lta'i mas ji ltar phan btags pa ltar bsam sbyor gnyis kyi sgo nas btags par nges pas drin che'o/ /snyam du bsam pa'o/ /gsum pa drin gzo ba ni/ de lta bu'i drin can de yal bar 'dor na ni ma rabs yin pas/ nam yang yal bar 'dor mi rigs so/ /snyam nas drin lan bskor ba'i khur 'khyer ba'o/ /de ltar byas na ni/ sems can thams cad bu sdug ltar mthong ba'i yid 'ong gi rnam pa can gyi byams pa skye'o/ /gnyis pa gzhan don don gnyer gyi blo bskyed pa dngos la gsum ste/ byams/ snying rje/ lhag bsam bsgom pa'o/ /dang po byams pa ni/ dmigs pa sems can la dmigs nas/ rnam pa sems can de bde ba dang ldan 'dod kyi rnam pa can yin pas/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang phrad na ci ma rung*/ phrad par gyur cig /phrad par bya'o snyam du yang yang bsam zhing brjod pa'o/ / de'i phan yon ni/ ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ bye ba khrag khrig dkrigs pa'i zhing dag na/ /mchod pa rnam mang dpag med ji snyed pa/ /skyes mchog rnams la de yis rtag mchod pas/ /byams pa'i sems kyi grangs dang char mi phod/ /ces dang*/ mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ rjes su chos sum brgya'i kha zas dag /nyin re dus gsum sbyin pas kyang*/ /byams pa yud tsam thang cig gi /bsod nams dag la char mi phod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar dran par bya'o/ /gnyis pa snying rje ni/ dmigs pa sems can la dmigs nas/ rnam pa sems can de sdug bsngal dang bral 'dod kyi rnam pa can yin pas/ sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang bral na ci ma rung*/ bral bar gyur cig /bral bar bya'o snyam du yang yang bsam zhing brjod pa'o/ /phan yon ni/ mdo las/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpas chos gcig rab tu bzung zhing rab tu rtogs par bgyis na/

sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad de'i lag mthil du mchis pa lags so/ /chos gcig pu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ snying rje chen po'o/ /zhes sogs phan yon dpag med bshad do/ /gzhan yang snying rje chen po ni/ theg chen lam gyi rtsa bar 'gyur ba dang*/ thog mtha' bar gsum du gal che tshul la sogs kyang bsam par bya'o/ /byams snying rje gnyis bsgom pa'i go rim ni/ thog mar gnyen dang mdza' bshes/ de nas bar ma/ de'i rjes su dgra la dmigs nas bsgom par bya ba la 'dra'o/ /de la goms na sems can spyi la dmigs nas bsgom par bya ste/ gzhan du na phyogs ris can du skye ba sogs su 'gyur ro/ /sems can bde ba dang ldan 'dod kyi byams pa dang*/ sdug bsngal las thar 'dod kyi snying rje ni/ nyan rang la'ang yod la/ sems can thams cad bde ba la 'god 'dod kyi byams pa dang*/ sdug bsngal las skyob 'dod kyi snying rje chen po ni/ de dag la med cing theg chen gyi khyad chos su 'gyur bas 'dir de ltar bsgom pa yin no/ /spyir byams snying rje gnyis kyi tshad rdzogs pa slar yang de lta bu'i byams pa dang snying rje skyes pa'i tshad ni/ dper na/ bu gcig pa la mas dmigs nas bde ba la 'god 'dod dang*/ sdug bsngal las skyob 'dod kyi blo skye ba'i tshod tsam du/ sems can gang la dmigs kyang de bde ba la 'god 'dod dang*/ sdug bsngal las skyob 'dod kyi blo rang gi ngang gis skye ba na/ sngar bshad pa'i byams snying rje gnyis rdzogs pa yin no/ /de yang dgos pa'i dbang gis sems can 'ga' zhig la cung zad gnod pa dang*/ re zhig la btang snyoms su 'jog dgos pa'ang srid kyang*/ spyir sems can de byams pa dang snying rje'i dmigs yul du byed pa 'dor du mi rung ba yin no/ /ma la ni bu de sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba'i tshe rang yang sdug bsngal du 'gyur ba'i brtse ba skye yang*/ sangs rgyas dang sems dpa' chen po rnams la ni de ltar mi 'byung ste/

'byung na sangs rgyas yang sdug bsngal dang bcas par thal bar 'gyur ro/ /des na/ ma bu gcig pa la brtse ba'i tshod tsam zhig sems can gzhan la byams snying rje skye dgos par gsungs pa'i don la zhig cha 'byed dgos kyi tshig tsam zhig la 'khrus par mi bya'o/ /gsum pa lhag bsam ni/ de ltar byams pa dang snying rje gnyis bsgom pa'i mthar/ kye ma sems can 'di mtha' dag bde ba thams cad dang ldan pa dang sdug bsngal thams cad las thar par nges par bdag gis bya'o/ /byed nus par gyur cig snyam du snying thag pa nas yang yang bsam zhing brjod de sbyong ba'o/ /gnyis pa byang chub don gnyer gyi blo sbyong ba ni/ gzhan don du rdzogs byang thob dgos par ma zad/ rang gi don du'ang de thob pa med du mi rung ba la nges pa drangs nas/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan rnams dran par byas te/ de lta bu'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang bdag gis thob par bya'o snyam pa'i blo brtan po bskyed par bya'o/ /gnyis pa rgyal sras zhi ba lha nas brgyud pa ni/ bdag gzhan mnyam pa brje'i sgo nas sbyong tshul te/ de ni spyod 'jug las/ bdag bde gzhan gyi sdug bsngal dag /yang dag brje bar ma byas na/ /sangs rgyas nyid du mi 'grub cing*/ /'khor ba na yang bde ba med/ /ces sogs gsungs pa ltar ro/ /sbyong tshul bsdu na 'di ltar bya ste/ sems can thams cad ma dang 'dra ba'i drin che tshul sogs sngar ltar bsam pa yang yin mod/ drin che'am chung yang bla'i/ rang nyid kyi ngos nas ni/ spyod 'jug las/ sems can rnams dang rgyal ba las/ /sangs rgyas chos 'grub 'dra ba la/ /rgyal la gus byed de bzhin du/ /sems can la min ci yi tshul/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ yon tan spyi dang*/ khyad par du sangs rgyas thob par 'dod na ni/ sems can gyi don byed dgos shing*/ de la rang gtso bor gces su 'dzin pa 'gog ci thub dang*/ sems can gzhan gtso bor gces su 'dzin pa bskyed ci thub byas nas byang chub tu sems bskyed dgos pa la nges pa drangs te/

rang gi sna bug g.yas kyi rlung phyir bus pa dang mnyam du rang gi bde dge thams cad rlung la zhon nas 'od zer dkar bo'i rnam par song ste/ sems can thams cad kyi sna bug g.yon pa nas zhugs/ lus kyi nang thams cad bde dges khyab song snyam du bsam pa dang*/ yang rang gi sna bug g.yon nas rlung nang du rngub pa dang mnyam du sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal dang de'i rgyu las nyon dang bcas pa thams cad 'od zer nag po'i rnam par rlung la zhon nas de rnams kyi sna bug g.yas pa nas drangs te/ rang gi sna bug g.yon pa nas zhugs/ snying gar nag phung nger gnas par gyur song snyam du snying thag pa nas yang yang bsam zhing*/ gtong len bya ste/ paṇa chen rin po ches/ gtong len rlung la bskyon pa'i 'phrul bdeg can/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i don yang de ltar ro/ /lugs de gnyis gang byas kyang sbyong shes na ni/ byang chub kyi sems skye ba la khyad par mi snang zhing*/ gdul bya'i rigs 'ga' zhig la snga ma dang*/ 'ga' zhig la ni phyi ma skyong bde bar 'ong ngo*/ /bdun pa skyes pa'i tshad ni/ sngar ngo bo bshad pa'i skabs ltar dang*/ sgom rim las kyang*/ de ltar snying rje chen po goms pa'i stobs kyis sems can ma lus pa drang bar dam bcas nas bla na med par yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu smon pa'i rang bzhin gyi byang chub kyi sems bsgrim mi dgos par skye ste/ zhes gsungs te/ 'di'i don ni lam rim las/ 'dis ni byang chub kyi sems skyes pa'i tshad kyang shes par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /go bder brjod na/ theg chen sems bskyed dngos ni/ sems can thams cad bde ba la 'god 'dod kyi byams pa dang*/ sdug bsngal las skyob 'dod snying rje/ lhag bsam dang bcas pa rdzogs par rang rgyud la skyes pa'i mjug de ma thag skye bar 'gyur ba yin no/ /des na theg chen sems bskyed mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa la/

rang gzhan gyi don du rdzogs byang don gnyer gyi 'dun pa gnyis tshang dgos kyang*/ rang gzhan re re ba tsam gyi ched du rdzogs byang thob 'dod kyi sems la yang*/ sems bskyed zhes mang du gsungs pa yod de/ lam rim las/ gsung rab dang bstan bcos gzhan las kyang sangs rgyas kyi gzugs kyi sku dang chos kyi sku'i yon tan mthong ba tsam gyis drangs pa'i sangs rgyas thob 'dod la sems bskyed du bshad pa mang po snang ba dang*/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas la 'god par yid dam bcas pa'ang sems bskyed du gsungs pa snang bas de gnyis re re yang sems bskyed pa tsam gyi grangs su bgrangs dgos la/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /brgyad pa sems de ma skyes pa myur du skye ba dang skyes zin brten pa'i phyir du tshogs 'dzin tshul klu sgrub thogs med zhi ba lha gsum gyi bzhed pa gcig tu bsgril nas 'chad pa la gsum/ ma thob pa thob par byed pa/ thob pa mi nyams pa srung ba/ nyams na phyir bcos pa'o/ /dang po la gsum las/ yul gang la len pa ni/ sems bskyed cing 'jug sdom thog pa zhig las len dgos so/ / rten gang gis len pa ni/ lam rim las/ sngar bshad pa ltar lam gyi rim pa la blo sbyangs pas byang chub kyi sems la yid 'gyur ba'i nyams myong cung zad rnyed pa zhig la byed pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /ji ltar len pa'i cho ga la sbyor dngos mjug gsum las/ dang po sbyor ba la/ skyabs su 'gro ba/ tshogs gsog pa/ bsam pa sbyang ba gsum las/ dang po ni/ gnas brgyan cing rten bkram nas mchod pa bsham pa dang*/ gsol ba gdab cing skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ de'i bslab bya brjod pa'o/ /de yang gnas bzang zhing dben pa'i sa phyogs su sa gzhi la ba byung dang tsan dan la sogs pa'i dri chus byug cing me tog gi gsol ma gtor la/ stegs la sogs pa'i steng du ston pa'i sku la sogs pa dkon mchog gsum gyi rten gang 'dzom bzhugs su bcug

/bla re dang gdugs sogs dang me tog dang zhal zas la sogs pa'i mchod pa bzang ba rnams sta gon bya zhing*/ bla ma la gdan khri me tog gis brgyan pa'ang bsham/ mchod pa sogs 'byor na ni phun sum tshogs pa zhig byed dgos la/ med na ci 'grub kyis kyang 'thus/ de nas bla mas 'phags pa'i tshogs spyan drangs te mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs lan gsum gdon cing bstod pa byas nas/ slob mas khrus byas gos bzang bo gyon te thal mo sbyor ba la/ bla mas tshogs zhing gi yon tan la snying thag pa nas dang ba bskyed du bcug ste/ sangs rgyas byang sems de dag re re'i drung du rang nyid 'dug par bsams nas/ dal bus yan lag 'dun pa byed du gzhug go /de nas bla ma la ston pa'i 'du shes bzhag ste/ phyag 'tshal ba dang yon dang maṇḍal rnams phul la/ pus mo g.yas pa btsugs nas thal mo sbyar te byang chub kyi sems kyi don du gsol ba gdab pa ni/ ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang byang chub sems dpa' chen po sa chen po la bzhugs pa rnams kyis dang por bla na med pa yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu thugs bskyed pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'ang slob dpon gyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed du gsol/ zhes lan gsum brjod pa'i rjes zlos byar gzhug /de nas skyabs 'gro khyad par can ni/ theg pa chen po'i dkon mchog gsum la sems can thams cad kyi phyir byang chub kyi bar du skyabs su 'gro bar 'dod pa'i 'dun pa drag pos/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying bo la mchis kyi bar du/ rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying bo la mchis kyi bar du/

chos rnams kyi mchog zhi ba 'dod chags dang bral ba'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying bo la mchis kyi bar du/ tshogs rnams kyi mchog 'phags pa byang chub sems dpa' phyir mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes lan gsum brjod cing rjes zlos bya/ skyabs su song ba'i bslab bya brjod pa ni/ spyi dang 'dra'o/ /gnyis pa tshogs gsog pa ni/ 'dir yang bzang spyod sogs nas 'byung ba'i yan lag bdun pa bya'o/ /gsum pa bsam pa sbyang ba ni/ sngar ltar byams snying rje'i dmigs pa dang rnam pa gsal gdab par bya'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i cho ga ni/ slob dpon gyi mdun du tsog pu'am sngar bzhin 'dug ste thal mo sbyar nas sems bskyed par bya ste/ de yang sems bskyed pa de byang chub kyi bar du mi btang ngo snyam du dam bca' ba'i bsam pa cho ga la brten nas bskyed pa yin no/ /de lta bu ni smon sems kyi bslab bya la slob nus na bya zhing mi nus na mi bya la/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya'o snyam pa tsam cho gas bskyed na ni/ sems bskyed kyi bslab bya la slob nus mi nus kun la byas chog par bshad do/ /smon sems la de ltar rung gi /'jug sems cho gas 'dzin pa ni/ de'i bslab bya la slob mi nus na rnam pa thams cad du byar mi rung ngo*/ /sems bzung ba'i cho ga dngos ni/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas skye ba 'di dang skye ba gzhan dang gzhan dag tu/ sbyin pa'i rang bzhin dang tshul khrims kyi rang bzhin dang bsgoms pa'i rang bzhin gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba dang bdag gis bgyis pa dang bgyid du stsal ba dang bgyid pa la rjes su yi rang ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba des/

ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang sa chen po la rab tu bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu thugs bskyed par mdzad pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub chen po la sems bskyed par bgyi'o/ /sems can ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi'o/ /ma grol ba rnams grol bar bgyi'o/ / dbugs ma byin pa rnams dbugs dbyung bar bgyi'o/ /yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams mya ngan las 'da' bar bgyi'o/ /zhes lan gsum brjod pa'i rjes zlos bya'o/ /de ni slob dpon yod pa'i lugs yin la/ slob dpon ma rnyed na ni/ thub dbang sogs rgyal ba sras bcas la dmigs te/ phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod pa'i cho ga la sogs pa byas nas gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ slob dpon zhes bya ba'i tshig dor ba'i skyabs 'gro sogs go rim sngar bzhin bya bar gsung*/ de dag ni smon sems cho gas 'dzin tshul te/ 'jug sems cho gas 'dzin cing 'jug sdom len tshul ni rje'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi le'u rnam bshad las shes par bya zhing*/ sngags rim sogs las ni/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ zhes sogs kyis 'jug sdom 'dzin par yang bshad do/ /gsum pa mjug chog ni/ bla mas smon sems kyi bslab bya 'chad pa ltar slob ma la brjod par bya ba'o/ /gnyis pa thob pa mi nyams par bsrung ba'i bslab bya la gnyis/ tshe 'dir sems bskyed mi nyams pa'i rgyu dang*/ skye ba gzhan du de dang mi 'bral ba'i rgyu la bslab pa'o/ /dang po la bzhi/ phan yon dran pa dang*/ lan drug tu bskyed pa dang*/ sems can blos mi spang ba dang*/ tshogs gnyis la bslab pa'o/ /dang po ni/

sngar bshad zin cing*/ sdong bo bkod pa'i mdo sogs la blta bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ smon sems mi gtong ba dang*/ spel ba'o/ /dang po ni/ sems de bskyed nas nam yang mi gtong ba la bslab par bya ste/ de ma btang na byang sems kyi tshul khrims mi nyams pa'i phan yon sogs yod la btang na de nyams nas sor thar kyi pham pa las kyang nyes pa ches shin tu lci ba 'byung ba'i phyir te/ nyan rang yid byed 'gogs pa'i sdom pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims mchog yin pas/ de ma dor na 'dod yon la 'dzem med spyod kyang byang sems kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i sdom pa ma zhig pa yin la/ de dor na ni so thar dag kyang byang sems ky-i thun mong ma yin pa'i tshul khrims 'chal bar 'gyur ba lam rim las bshad cing*/ sdud pa las kyang gal te byang chub sems dpa' 'dod yon lnga spyod kyang*/ sangs rgyas chos dang 'phags pa'i dge 'dun skyabs song ste/ sangs rgyas 'grub bya snyam du kun mkhyen yid byed na/ mkhas pa tshul khrims pha rol phyin gnas rig par bya/ gal te bskal ba bye bar dge ba'i las lam bcu/ spyod kyang rang rgyal dgra bcom gnyid la 'dod bskyed na/ de tshe tshul khrims skyon byung tshul khrims nyams pa yin/ sems bskyed de ni phas pham las kyang shin tu lci/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /der ma zad/ rang don tsam gyi yid byed dang bral zhing theg pa chen po'i byang chub tu sems bskyed nas sems can thams cad kyi don bya bar 'dod pa'i go cha ma nyams na grong dang tshogs mang bo'i nang du gnas kyang byang sems kyi dben pa mchog tu gnas pa yin la/ de nyams pa'i gang zag ni lo bye bar yang mi gzhan dang mi phrad par 'du 'dzi spangs pa'i dben par gnas kyang*/ byang sems kyi dbang du byas pa'i dben pa mchog la gnas pa dang bral zhing 'dre bar gnas pa yin te/ sdud pa las/ gang zhig grong ngam 'on te dgon par gnas kyang rung*/

/theg pa gnyis kyi sems bral byang chub mchog nges na/ /'di ni 'gro don zhugs pa rnams kyi dben pa ste/ zhes dang*/ rtag tu grong dang yul 'khor grong rdal gnas byed cing*/ /sems can smin byed byang chub brtson pa mi gtogs par/ /de ni dgra bcom rang rgyal 'dod pa gzhar mi bskyed/ /'di ni bde bar gshegs pa'i sras kyi dben par gsung*/ /gang zhig dpag tshad lnga brgya yod pa'i ri yi sul/ / sbrul gyis gang ba lo mar bye bar gnas byed kyang*/ /dben pa 'di mi shes pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de/ /lhag pa'i nga rgyal rnyed nas 'dre bar gnas pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang*/ de bzhin du rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum las kyang 'byung ngo*/ /gnyis pa spel ba ni/ de ltar ma btang ba tsam gyis mi chog pas nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum du bzung zhing spel bar bya'o/ /de yang sngar bshad pa'i cho ga rgyas pa grub na de bzhin du bya la/ ma grub na tshogs zhing gsal btab nas mchod pa dang byams snying rje sogs sbyangs te/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ /zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad 'di lan gsum gsum brjod nas bzung bar bya ste/ 'di ni smon sems kyi bslab bya thun mong ma yin pa'o/ /spyir sems bskyed kyi cho ga rgyas pa ma lcogs pa'i tshe yang phyag len bzhin/ rten gyi drung du skyabs 'gro yan lag bdun pa rnams spyi 'gro ltar byas nas/ 'di lan gsum brjod de/ bzung yang rung ngo*/ /gsum pa sems can blos mi spang ba ni/ sems can thams cad byams snying rje'i dmigs yul du byas nas yal bar mi 'dor ba yin la/ blos spangs pa'i tshad ni/ sus mi 'thad pa zhig byas pa'i rkyen gyis/ da ni nam du'ang 'di'i don mi bya'o snyam pa'i bsam pa skyes pa ste/ 'di byung na sems bskyed zin pa'ang gtong bas shin tu gzab par bya'o/ /bzhi ba tshogs gnyis la bslab pa ni/ smon sems cho gas bzung ba nas zhag re re bzhin du byang chub kyi sems 'phel ba'i rgyur dkon mchog mchod pa dang bsngo smon sogs la 'bad par bya'o/

/ gnyis pa skye ba gzhan du de dang mi 'bral ba'i rgyu la bslab pa la gnyis/ nag chos bzhi spong ba dang*/ dkar chos bzhi blang ba'o/ /dang po ni/ mkhan slob dang bla ma dang sbyin gnas la brdzun gyis dbu skor byed pa dang*/ 'gyod pa'i gnas ma yin pa dge ba byas pa lta bu la 'gyod du bcug pa dang*/ byang sems la zhe sdang gis smod pa dang*/ bre srang sogs la g.yo sgyu byed pa ste bzhi bo spong ba la bslab par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ sems can thams cad la brdzun smra ba spong ba dang*/ de rnams la g.yo sgyu mi byed pa dang*/ byang sems thams cad la ston pa dang 'dra ba'i 'du shes bskyed cing bsngags pa brjod pa dang*/ rang gi gdul bya rnams rdzogs byang la 'god par 'dod pa ste bzhi yin la/ de dag ni nag chos bzhi'i gnyen po'o/ /'di rnams ni smon 'jug thun mong ba'i bslab bya'o/ /smon sems tsam cho gas bzung bas ni/ spyod pa phyin drug la bslab nus na ma gtogs/ mi nus na ma bslabs kyang mi 'gal yang*/ 'jug sdom cho gas blangs phyin de dag la nges par bslab dgos par bshad do/ /gsum pa nyams na phyir bcos pa ni/ sangs rgyas thos 'dod kyi smon sems dang sems can gyi don bya 'dod btang na ni sems bskyed kyang gtong la/ bslab bya gzhan dang 'gal na stobs bzhi'i bshags sdom mang du bya zhing*/ khyad par byang sems kyi sdom pa thob nas ni/ phyir bcos ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin bya dgos so/ /byang sems kyi sdom pa ni/ 'dir 'jug sdom la byed cing*/ 'di so thar dang sngags kyi sdom pa dang mi 'dra bas thog ma nyid nas len yul bla ma ma rnyed na/ rang gis rten gyi drung du blangs kyang skye bar bshad do/ /dgu pa 'phros don sems bskyed nas spyod pa gang la slob pa la gnyis te/ rang rgyud smin byed phyin drug dang*/ gzhan rgyud smin byed bsdu bzhi la bslab pa'i tshul lo/ /'di dag gi rnam gzhag ni rgyas par gzhan nas shes par bya zhing*/

'dir phar phyin drug po re re la'ang drug ldan du bya ba'i tshul tsam ni/ byang sems kyis chos sbyin lta bu zhig byed pa na/ nyan rang gi yid byed sdom pa'i sems pa ni tshul khrims/ rnam mkhyen dang chos zab mo la mos shing gzhan gyis gshe ba la bzod pa ni bzod pa/ dge ba'i chos 'phel ba'i phyir du der brtson pa ni brtson 'grus/ dman pa'i yid byed dang ma 'dres par dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngo ba'i sems rtse gcig pa ni bsam gtan/ sbyin sogs kyi 'khor gsum bden stong sgyu ma lta bur shes pa ni shes rab po/ /tshul khrims srung ba'i tshe rang tshul khrims la gnas nas gzhan de la 'god pa ni tshul khrims kyi sbyin pa/ de bzhin du bzod pa/ brtson 'grus/ bsam gtan/ shes rab rnams la rang gnas nas gzhan yang de la 'god pa ni/ de dag ni sbyin pa yin la/ lhag ma rnams sbyin pa la bshad pa bzhin sbyar bar bya'o/ /smras pa/ thob bya phul byung 'bras bu chos kyi sku/ /thob byed phul byung byang chub sems mchog nyid/ /mkhas pa'i phul byung rje btsun btsong kha ba'i/ /man ngag phul byung lam rim ji bzhin bshad/ /gang dag theg pa chen po'i gzhung lugs la/ /ci tsam mang du thos shing sbyangs byas kyang*/ /tshul 'dir nyams len phyogs tsam med gyur na/ /dgos don snying bo stong pa yin nam snyam/ zhes pa 'di yang*/ shākya'i dge slong bshad sgrub ming can gyis rang gi slob ma ri khrod 'dzin pa'i dge slong shes rab bkra shis la phan par 'gyur snyam pa'i bsam pas bgyis pa ste/ 'dis kyang rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che la phan thogs par gyur cig /maṅga lam// //

mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/byang chub kyi sems bskyed tshul rje bla ma'i dgongs pa gsal bar byed pa rgyal sras 'jug ngogs bzhugs/ - PAGE 174-- PAGE 173-- PAGE 153-
